thread:
sara: Thanks everyone for the all-hands — quick follow-up thread. I want one concise set of confirmed windows/owners for API, Console, and Optimize so we can update customers and sales.
emily: Short version: API GA target 2026-09-15 (internal), Console revamp GA end-of-Nov 2026, Optimize beta starts 2026-07-01. Owners: emily (API), kevin (Console), raj (Optimize). Will confirm details.
raj: Optimize depends on runtime batching + kernel selection landing. PR #482 + perf tests need to be green — current ETA for that infra work is 2026-06-20.
kevin: Console needs SDK parity too. DevEx plan: JS SDK parity by 2026-09-01, Python by 2026-10-01. Samples and migration guides after that.
lisa: Prioritization note — prioritize API GA for hosted customers, Dedicated rollout should be a staged follow-on with canary access for key enterprise tenants.
chris: Heads-up: Dedicated autoscale changes are on the critical path for the Console admin features (route control + rollout UI). I'll add tasks to eng-platform backlog and tag owners.
emily: To be explicit on scope: API GA = streaming + function/tool calls + rate limits + basic analytics; Console GA = route/model dashboards + rollout/canary UI; Optimize beta = batching suggestions + quantization hints + perf recommendations.
kevin: Docs/devex asks: sample apps, migration guide, and a short 'what's changed' doc. We can deliver a sample repo by 2026-07-10 and guides shortly after.
sara: Can engineering and product 'accept' these dates by EOD Friday so we can publish a customer-facing schedule?
raj: Conditional accept — will confirm after running the upcoming perf sweep on 6/18. If perf regresses we'll surface blockers. :thumbsup:
emily: Product accepts the dates and will update the roadmap board. I'll ping sales and CS with a pre-brief once engineering confirms.
chris: Finance note: infra cost model indicates Dedicated autoscale change may temporarily increase infra spend ~+10% during initial rollout window. Flagging for finance ops.
kevin: DevEx will coordinate with Solutions Eng for the sample apps and will schedule a docs freeze two weeks before each GA.
allhands-bot: Created task #7543 "Roadmap confirm: API/Console/Optimize dates" and assigned to emily, raj, kevin. Due 2026-06-20.
sara: Thanks — I'll schedule a short follow-up sync Thursday 10:00am PT to lock any final scope cuts. Invite going out now.
lisa: One ask from leadership — trim non-critical Console UI polish from GA scope so we can guarantee the November GA date. @emily please confirm.
emily: Agreed. We'll move non-essential polish to a post-GA milestone and update the scope doc.
raj: After perf sweep, I'll post a short status update in this thread with any blockers.
kevin: I'll create the sample repo stub today and share the repo link here when ready.
sara: Perfect — appreciate the quick turn. :rocket:
